summary: Iteration 272: Glitch Log & SOPs Library (Flexkeeping-style Quality Assurance modules) fully tested. All 52 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified - both modules accessible via Operations > Quality Assurance section with Turkish UI.
critical_code_review_comments: GLITCH LOG: POST /api/glitch-log creates glitch with property_id, title, severity (info|minor|major|critical), department (7 options), shift (morning|afternoon|night) - all enum validations working (400 on invalid)
GLITCH LOG: GET /api/glitch-log/{property_id} lists glitches with filters (status, severity, shift, department, days). property_id='all' spans all properties
GLITCH LOG: PATCH /api/glitch-log/{id} updates fields; resolving sets resolved_by/resolved_at automatically
GLITCH LOG: POST /api/glitch-log/{id}/acknowledge marks as read by current user (idempotent via $addToSet)
GLITCH LOG: GET /api/glitch-log/handover/{property_id} returns items_by_severity grouped packet with summary counts
GLITCH LOG: DELETE requires admin/manager role (401/403 for non-auth)
SOPs: POST /api/sops creates SOP in draft status with steps[], target_roles[], category - validates category enum
SOPs: GET /api/sops lists SOPs (non-managers only see published status)
SOPs: GET /api/sops/{id} returns full detail with steps array
SOPs: POST /api/sops/{id}/publish moves status to published, sets published_at
SOPs: POST /api/sops/{id}/acknowledge adds current user to acknowledged_by (only works on published SOPs)
SOPs: PATCH /api/sops/{id} updates; if steps changed, version bumps and acks reset
SOPs: GET /api/sops/{id}/acknowledgements (manager only) returns list of users who acked + count
SOPs: DELETE requires admin role only
Frontend: Sidebar Operations group shows 'QUALITY ASSURANCE' divider with 'Glitch log & devir' and 'SOP kütüphanesi' buttons
Frontend: data-testid='glitch-log-btn' and data-testid='sops-btn' present and functional
Frontend: Glitch panel has filters (status, severity, shift, department, days), create modal, handover modal
Frontend: SOP panel has search, category filter, status filter, create modal with steps builder, detail modal with publish/archive/ack buttons
Frontend: All UI text in Turkish as specified
seed_data_creation: Test data created via backend tests with TEST_ prefix for glitches and SOPs
context_for_next_testing_agent: Glitch Log & SOPs modules fully verified. Access via Operations > Quality Assurance section. Glitch endpoints: /api/glitch-log (CRUD + acknowledge + handover). SOP endpoints: /api/sops (CRUD + publish + acknowledge + acknowledgements + categories/list). Both use property_id='default' or 'all' for testing. Frontend buttons: data-testid='glitch-log-btn' and 'sops-btn'. Modals: 'glitch-create-modal', 'glitch-handover-modal', 'sop-create-modal', 'sop-detail-modal'.
